elements.note: The set's legend. Note the room tag carries FOUR pieces of information at once: room name, floor-finish number, floor level and ceiling number -- so a room tag on A-05/A-06 keys straight back into the material list on this sheet.

warnings: *** THE ARCHITECTURAL SET HAS ITS OWN DRAWING NUMBER: AR 61142, not the structural set's S 62047. *** Both are dated ม.ค. 2562 and belong to the same house, but they are separately numbered submissions. Do not treat the drawing number as a project id.
This sheet is three panels in one: the architectural sheet index (A-01..A-31), the material schedule keyed by the numbers that appear in room tags, and the symbol legend for the whole set.
THE INDEX CONFIRMS THE +2 PAGE OFFSET for the architectural set too -- A-01 is printed page 1 and is PNG 03. maps_to_png is derived on each entry, not printed.

MATERIAL NUMBERS ARE THE KEY TO THE FLOOR PLANS. Room tags on A-05/A-06 carry a floor-finish number, a level and a ceiling number, all of which resolve against the lists here: floors 1-5, walls 1-2, ceilings 1-5. A plan tag reading '1 +0.00 1' means vinyl tile, datum level, standard gypsum ceiling.
FIRST MENTION OF THE ROOF COVERING IN THE WHOLE SET: the insulation note says the roof is มุงด้วยกระเบื้องลอนคู่ (double-corrugated tile). S-05 and S-06 gave only the steel frame beneath it.
The insulation requirement is a MINIMUM with two carve-outs: foil-wrapped glass wool not less than 2" over ceilings generally, but NOT over bathrooms and NOT outside the building.

Skirting is specified only for floor type 1 (vinyl tile) and ceiling trim only for ceiling types 1-4. Those restrictions are printed in the entries themselves and are kept in the notes rather than being generalised.
